machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

conditions.ordering: The 25-step run immediately followed the 13-step run and therefore began from a hotter sustained state.
conditions.scope: Transformer startup, conditioning, and denoising only; no text encoder, VAE, or PNG output.

benchmark_interface.schedule_note: One and two steps retain the first one/two values of the canonical 40-step schedule. Longer timing diagnostics use their requested step-count schedule; tensor shapes and operation counts are unchanged.

interpretation.evidence: Within both runs, fixed-shape cached steps do not become progressively slower. The already-hot second run begins at a uniformly lower throughput and recovers somewhat over time.
interpretation.likely_cause: Sustained hardware frequency and thermal state; direct temperature/frequency telemetry was unavailable because powermetrics requires superuser access.
interpretation.benchmark_policy: Use adjacent short A/B pairs for kernel acceptance, and record AC/battery/order for long end-to-end observations.
